subject.title: feat(ui): session board grid engine and board view

question: Should the session-dashboard program accept this uninstantiated board rendering core and its temporary UI-local contract before gateway protocol and session-host integration are ready?
rationale: The patch adds a substantial feature foundation but intentionally defers the authoritative protocol and user-facing integration; that sequencing and contract ownership are product and architecture choices rather than mechanical review fixes.

options.title: Sponsor the staged foundation
options.body: Accept the board engine as an approved internal milestone, with a named follow-up that moves the local contract to the gateway protocol before production wiring.

options.title: Require protocol-first integration
options.body: Pause this branch until the gateway/session contract lands so the board view is built directly against the authoritative model.

options.title: Narrow to engine-only groundwork
options.body: Retain only the pure layout primitives and their tests, deferring UI cells, frame behavior, and fixture plumbing until the product contract is ready.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged foundation
recommendation.body: Accept the board engine as an approved internal milestone, with a named follow-up that moves the local contract to the gateway protocol before production wiring.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR positions this work as the first implementation piece of the dashboard program and references its architecture design.
